chunk: The master raised his staff, and the imp shrank back against the wall.
“You will not leave this room,” said the master, “until the circle is closed.”
Nell watched from the doorway, her hands pressed tightly against her mouth, and waited for something to happen.
The candles guttered and the smell of sulphur filled the room.

preceding.source: Nobody in the house was asleep.
